points.sub: Named partner before Charlotte's first ball

points: Official yoghurt partner of the WTA

caption:
FAGE has put its name on the biggest week in women's tennis.

It's the new title partner of the WTA Finals and official yoghurt partner of the WTA, through 2029. It starts at Indian Wells next month, then follows the Finals to Charlotte from 2027. No fee was disclosed.

Also today: Isuzu x Rugby World Cup 2027, Airwallex x McLaren, Northwest Bank x Columbus Crew.
